box.name: box
box.description: A standard 3D rectangular box defined by length, width, and height.

cylinder.name: cylinder
cylinder.description: A standard cylinder defined by its radius and height.

cone.name: cone
cone.description: A cone (or truncated cone / frustum) defined by base diameter, top diameter (default 0), and height.

top_diameter.description: Diameter of the top circle (0 for a sharp cone)

sphere.name: sphere
sphere.description: A sphere defined by its radius.

torus.name: torus
torus.description: A donut-shaped torus defined by the major (ring) radius and minor (tube) radius.

ring_radius.description: Distance from the center of the torus to the center of the tube

wedge.name: wedge
wedge.description: A standard wedge defined by length (dx), width (dy), height (dz), and offsets.

pyramid.name: pyramid
pyramid.description: A pyramid: rectangular base lofted to an apex point at the given height.

taper_angle.description: Unused (kept for schema compat); apex is a point

prism.name: prism
prism.description: A regular polygon prism defined by number of sides, radius, and height.

sides.description: Number of sides of the polygon base

radius.description: Distance from center to base vertices

hexagon_prism.name: hexagon_prism
hexagon_prism.description: A hexagonal prism defined by the flat-to-flat diameter and height.

octagonal_prism.name: octagonal_prism
octagonal_prism.description: An octagonal prism defined by flat-to-flat distance and height.

hollow_cylinder.name: hollow_cylinder
hollow_cylinder.description: A tube or hollow cylinder defined by outer radius, inner radius, and height.

hollow_box.name: hollow_box
hollow_box.description: A box hollowed out by removing the top face (+Z) with a specified wall thickness.

ellipsoid.name: ellipsoid
ellipsoid.description: A true ellipsoid: unit sphere scaled to x_radius (X,Y) and z_radius (Z).

x_radius.description: Radius along X and Y axes

capsule.name: capsule
capsule.description: A cylinder capped with two spheres on each end.

chamfered_box.name: chamfered_box
chamfered_box.description: A rectangular box with chamfered edges.

filleted_box.name: filleted_box
filleted_box.description: A rectangular box with filleted edges.

rounded_cylinder.name: rounded_cylinder
rounded_cylinder.description: A cylinder with filleted end edges.

fillet_val.description: Fillet radius on the cylinder edges

ring.name: ring
ring.description: A flat concentric ring profile extruded to a thickness.

profile_extrude.name: profile_extrude
profile_extrude.description: Extrude an arbitrary closed 2D polygon profile (list of [x, y] points in mm) to a given height along +Z. Force-multiplier for brackets, cams, gears, and other prismatic parts the fixed primitives can't express.

profile.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) forming the closed cross-section; do not repeat the first point

loft.name: loft
loft.description: Blend one profile through N stations stacked along Z, each station optionally rotated about Z relative to the base. General-purpose: many stations with increasing rotation gives a continuously twisted blade/vane/propeller — a straight profile_extrude (no twist) and revolve (axisymmetric only) cannot express that. Also covers a simple 2-station taper by using the same profile at both heights (shape stays constant, only rotation varies).

profile.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) forming the closed cross-section used at EVERY station; do not repeat the first point

heights.description: Z height (mm) of each station, strictly ascending, first value usually 0. Same length as rotations — heights[i] pairs with rotations[i].

rotations.description: Rotation (degrees, about Z) applied to the profile at each station before blending, same length as heights. Increasing values here are what produces a continuous twist — e.g. [0, 20, 45] over 3 stations twists 45 degrees total by the tip.

ruled.description: False (default) = smooth blended loft; True = straight-line (ruled) surfaces between stations

sweep.name: sweep
sweep.description: Sweep a closed 2D profile along a 3D path (a spline through the given points) to build tubes, rails, pipe bends, or any part whose cross-section rides along a curved centerline. Complements loft: sweep varies POSITION along a path with a fixed profile, loft varies PROFILE/rotation across fixed Z stations.

profile.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) forming the closed cross-section, drawn on the XY plane at the path's start; do not repeat the first point

path.description: Ordered list of [x, y, z] points (mm) the profile is swept along, spline-interpolated; first point should be [0,0,0] (the profile's own plane)

multisection.description: False (default) = one fixed profile swept along the path; True = treat profile as the first of multiple sections (advanced — leave False unless blending profiles along the path)

taper_extrude.name: taper_extrude
taper_extrude.description: Extrude a closed 2D polygon profile along +Z with a draft/taper angle, so the cross-section shrinks (positive taper) or grows (negative) as it rises. Use for drafted bosses, funnels with straight walls, truncated pyramid-like prisms of ANY cross-section — a plain profile_extrude has no taper, and cone/pyramid only offer fixed circular/rectangular sections.

profile.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) forming the closed cross-section at the base; do not repeat the first point

taper_angle.description: Draft angle in degrees; positive tapers inward going up (narrower top), negative flares outward. Keep small enough that the section doesn't collapse before reaching full height.

loft_between.name: loft_between
loft_between.description: Loft a smooth solid between two DIFFERENT closed 2D profiles: profile_bottom at Z=0 blending into profile_top at Z=height (optionally rotated about Z). Use for square-to-round adapters, funnels, nozzle transitions, ergonomic grips — any shape-to-shape morph. Distinct from loft (one profile through many twisted stations) and taper_extrude (same shape, straight drafted walls).

profile_bottom.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) for the closed cross-section at Z=0; do not repeat the first point

profile_top.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) for the closed cross-section at Z=height; approximate circles with a 16-24 point polygon

height.description: Z height of the top profile above the bottom one

rotation_deg.description: Optional rotation (degrees about Z) of the top profile relative to the bottom — adds a twist to the transition

tube.name: tube
tube.description: Hollow circular tube swept along a 3D path: pipes, elbows, ducts, conduits, handles, roll-cage bars. The path is spline-interpolated through the given points; the wall is formed by cutting an inner sweep from an outer one (the safe idiom — sweeping a pre-cut ring is degenerate). For a SOLID bar along a path use sweep instead.

wall.description: Wall thickness (mm); must be smaller than radius

path.description: Ordered list of [x, y, z] points (mm) the tube's centerline follows, spline-interpolated; first point should be [0,0,0]

helix_sweep.name: helix_sweep
helix_sweep.description: A round wire wound into a helix rising along +Z: coil springs, spiral coils, decorative threads, helical channels (as a cut). Total coil turns = height / pitch. For a straight or gently-curved bar use sweep; for a hollow pipe use tube.

coil_radius.description: Radius of the helix centerline from the Z axis (mm)

pitch.description: Z distance between successive turns (mm); must exceed 2*wire_radius or the coils self-intersect

height.description: Total height of the helix along Z (mm)

wire_radius.description: Radius of the round wire being wound (mm)

revolve.name: revolve
revolve.description: Revolve a closed 2D profile (list of [x, y] points, all x >= 0) about the Y axis to sweep a solid of revolution. Force-multiplier for bottles, nozzles, flanges, and turned parts.

profile.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points (mm) with x >= 0; revolved about the line x = 0 (the Y axis)

angle.description: Sweep angle in degrees (360 for a full solid of revolution)
